evidence_units.claim: Dynamic planning can violate tool dependencies, whereas fixed pipelines can be redundant and generalize poorly.
NeSy-Spatial separates typed atomic instructions, Tool-Use Skills, Geometry Skills, execution trajectories, and evolution.

Buffered trajectories drive analysis, fusion, and tenure-aware pruning between episodes.

evidence_units.claim: Online evolution exceeds Frozen by 12.5, 3.5, and 2.5 points on MindCube, MMSI, and OmniSpatial; macro average is 54.2 to 60.3.
Full configuration is 71.50/49.50/60.27; disabling evolution, Tool-Use, or Geometry yields the reported drops.
MindCube camera-motion case reconstructs a shared scene and returns diagonally forward-left (C) from camera-0-frame geometry.
MMSI grounded-object case detects a framed painting, projects its box to 3D, and returns front-left (C) in Image 2.
OmniSpatial allocentric case estimates the screen pose and returns the fan on the screen's right.
Failure analysis adds destination grounding and forward-motion comparison after a turn; geometry evolution adds guarded dynamic option parsing.
